allowed: hash-verify and synthesize statistics already published in the named receipts
audit whether chronology, training-window size, and data-source era are identifiable from the published design
rank prospective routes without opening a new outcome
forbidden: open corpus outcomes to create a new statistic, comparator, threshold, or verdict
create a Phase 5 declaration or DeclaredFitPermit
treat this synthesis as independent confirmation

known_before_this_synthesis.interpretation: These are inherited published observations, not blinded discoveries. This precommit governs only their deterministic synthesis and the prospective route rules below.

primary_discriminating_statistics.fixed_fit_material_contrast_usd: mean(entry ordering edge in score blocks 3-4) minus mean(entry ordering edge in blocks 0-2)
primary_discriminating_statistics.fixed_fit_label_contrast_pp: mean(entry ordering hit-rate edge in score blocks 3-4) minus mean(entry ordering hit-rate edge in blocks 0-2)
primary_discriminating_statistics.phase4b_design_confounding: Spearman correlation between expanding training-session count and chronological fold index
primary_discriminating_statistics.score_design_confounding: whether recent-block indicator (blocks 3-4) equals owned-data-era indicator for every score block
primary_discriminating_statistics.source_overlap: number of same sessions observed under both owned and backfill quote laws

thresholds_and_verdict_law.fold_size_excluded_for_fixed_fit_score_g: TRUE only if one unchanged fitted model and one unchanged training prefix produced all five score blocks, fixed_fit_material_contrast_usd >= 4.00, and each recent block exceeds every earlier block. This excludes expanding fit size only for this fixed-fit score-period contrast.
thresholds_and_verdict_law.phase4b_regime_vs_expanding_window_separ: TRUE only if chronology and training size are not perfectly rank-confounded, or a published common-model/common-period comparison supplies orthogonal variation. Otherwise NOT_SEPARABLE.
thresholds_and_verdict_law.recent_regime_vs_data_era_separable: TRUE only if the recent indicator and source-era indicator are not identical and source_overlap > 0, or an equivalent published orthogonal design exists. Otherwise NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_ON_CURRENT_DATA.
thresholds_and_verdict_law.restart_evidence_floor: A future fixed-policy, session-unit analysis must be declared before outcomes and show a lower 95% bound above +4.00 USD per entry for the within-source regime contrast, with a same-direction ordering-label contrast of at least +0.50 percentage points and no greater than 2.50 percentage-point population label-composition shift. A same-date dual-source twin must either bound the source effect to +/-2.00 USD per entry or explicitly attribute the effect to source mechanics.
thresholds_and_verdict_law.current_route_finished: YES if either attribution comparison is structurally rank-confounded and no already-published orthogonal evidence breaks it. Finish as NOT_SEPARABLE; do not fit to resolve a design-identification failure.

expected_result_before_synthesis.fixed_fit_score_gradient: material, with expanding training-window size excluded by construction
expected_result_before_synthesis.phase4b_gradient: NOT_SEPARABLE between chronology/regime and expanding-window fit size
expected_result_before_synthesis.fixed_fit_recent_gradient: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE between genuine recent regime and the 2025-08-01 data-source era seam
expected_result_before_synthesis.overall: MIXED_NOT_SEPARABLE; no fit restart is justified on the current corpus
